title: stt.transcriptOutput node config (mandatory)
description: The pipeline's transcript sink — an empty config (no fields to author). Mirrors stt-ws.gateway.ts's single-consumer-per-session model: the compiler (TASK-724 Task 4) asserts exactly one stt.transcriptOutput node per graph, so there is no fan-out at the transcript sink in v1. The only externalWrite:true node in this palette.
